strings.Cosmo can make mistakes. Practice refini: Cosmo can make mistakes. Practice refining your prompts.
strings.Shape Cosmo's tone, style, persona, or e: Shape Cosmo's tone, style, persona, or expertise. Sent with each message and applied to your next reply. Cosmo's core guidelines and safety guardrails always take precedence.
strings.e.g. You are an expert in Data Science w: e.g. You are an expert in Data Science with an IQ of 159. Maintain a positive, helpful style.
strings.Controls randomness (0–2). Lower = more: Controls randomness (0–2). Lower = more focused, higher = more creative. Disabled when Thinking is on.
strings.Extended reasoning depth. When enabled,: Extended reasoning depth. When enabled, temperature is ignored by the model.
strings.This model does not support Thinking. Sw: This model does not support Thinking. Switch to a model that does, then update Thinking.
strings.Chat cannot start: the server is missing: Chat cannot start: the server is missing Octavus configuration. Create a .env in the project root with OCTAVUS_API_URL, OCTAVUS_API_KEY, and OCTAVUS_AGENT_ID, then stop the dev server completely and run npm run dev again (environment variables load only at startup).
strings.Could not start the app. Make sure npm r: Could not start the app. Make sure npm run dev is running and check the browser console for details.
strings.Wait for Cosmo to finish responding befo: Wait for Cosmo to finish responding before typing.
strings.Waiting for a response to finish (max {m: Waiting for a response to finish (max {max} at once)
strings.Up to {max} chats can respond at once: Up to {max} chats can respond at once
strings.Starting a new chat will <strong>permane: Starting a new chat will permanently delete your current conversation. This cannot be undone.
